initialProposedLimits.qualification: Design parameters only; use stricter existing bounds and verify P0 compatibility before implementation

workItems.title: Freeze actual capability, ingress and single-view baseline
deliverables: Complete authenticated caller to final input-consumer inventory, including direct/legacy/native routes
Document current off/cancellation, reference wiring, resource scopes and known single-view effect failures
Freeze supported exact adapter/app/build matrix, quiescence evidence and numeric limits before implementation
Classify and prioritize caller-unqualified operation-ID maps and unconditional paste-clipboard restoration before multi-writer enablement
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Introduce scoped view bindings and attenuated authority
deliverables: Versioned ViewBinding and broker-private ConversationGrant with caller, target and epoch binding
Known-process/window replacement, cross-caller, forged-label and delegated-scope refusal tests
No mutation or extra model worker in initial two-view mode
A view does not allocate a second native writer session for an already leased client; bind protected owner-issued connector identity rather than a free conversation string
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Add bounded consented observations and transition/freshness handling
deliverables: ObservationRef identity/geometry/topology epochs, completeness and transition labels
Latest-value coalescing, consent-isolated immutable cache and strict byte accounting
Event-aware observation with bounded polling fallback and off/revocation stopping new capture/delivery
No all-screen capture, content telemetry or retained image queue
Requested vs actual fallback format and text/image temporal consistency are truthful; text-only grants refuse image fallback and cursor-overlay rendering is qualified
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Expose host-neutral read-only status and human controls
expectedWriteScopes: Separately authorized host-adapter repository, if selected
deliverables: Versioned bounded events with sequence-gap requery and safe rendered labels
Two-view cards showing actual status, age/completeness/scope and explicit stop/takeover
No UI-created authority, automatic new agent, DSH server replacement or hidden view
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Qualify read-only two-view behavior and feature-off parity
deliverables: Deterministic hotplug/resize/scroll/navigation/reconnect/pressure fault tests
No focus/pointer changes or unapproved observation; partial/cross-view skew remains truthful
Initial feature-off creates no subscriptions/models/workers; no live desktop effect claim from fixtures
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Implement a conservative hierarchical resource arbiter
deliverables: All-or-none ordered acquisition, ancestor/descendant conflicts and app/document/seat/clipboard closure
Finite queues, fair scheduling, deadlines and no hold-and-wait resource upgrades
Known-quiescent device-wide enable transition for affected old and new writers
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Fence the last side-effect consumer with compatible cohorts
expectedWriteScopes: Native bridge/protocol files identified by MV-00
deliverables: ActionTicket grant, resource fence, binding and observation checks at actual dispatch
Reject queued old-generation commands and unsupported/mixed protocol consumers
Stage source/ABI-verified native changes without restarting a shared active broker
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Implement revocation, quiescent drain and uncertain-action recovery
deliverables: Consent revocation before next input, parent-child cancellation and scoped subscription stop
cancel_pending/draining/quarantined behavior, no TTL-based regrant or global human key release
Minimal safe action-intent/outcome journal; zero automatic uncertain-effect replay
Disable retains fences and barriers until quiescence; no automatic undo of external effects
Remove or refuse unsafe unconditional clipboard restoration on coordinated routes; never overwrite a later owner copy
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Cover every supported legacy and new action route
deliverables: CLI, MCP, batches, resume and applicable panel/native routes share resource and final-dispatch checks
Existing full/protected settings and ordinary clipboard policy preserved
No single-view/mixed-version bypass; refuse or defer active incompatible writer migration
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Qualify coordinated one-writer workflows and owner interference
expectedWriteScopes: Native owned-fixture tests identified by MV-00
deliverables: All applicable MV-SAFE scenarios mapped to deterministic tests, including no duplicate send/save/submit
Real exact original-app observe-act-settle-verify and human takeover evidence
Zero wrong-target/cross-scope actions; unknown quiescence blocks conflicting work
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Add optional host-supervised delegated readers and task dependencies
deliverables: Host-owned bounded DAG, explicit roles and attenuated caller grants
No provider engine in Orbit, worker per screen default or agent-label authority
No reassignment of uncertain side effects; parent revocation cancels descendants
Host budget declarations do not pretend to control unrelated external agents
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Measure, publish qualified limits and execute opt-in rollback drill
expectedWriteScopes: docs/release-notes or release document selected later
deliverables: Start with at least 20 paired cold and warm pilot samples per equivalent scenario, counterbalance and expand by predeclared precision/confidence rules before tail/regression release decisions; count failures and verification cost
Best/typical/worst completed-task time, tails, tokens, frame bytes, memory/CPU, waits and owner effects
Predeclared regression budgets, exact app/build matrix and no universal savings claim
Feature-disable/drain/rollback drill and source/runtime cohort checks before any release
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Optional independent native input-seat qualification
expectedWriteScopes: Separate adapter-specific research and acceptance scope, to be approved later
deliverables: Exact platform/compositor ABI, application builds and input-method capability matrix
Independent effect/focus/pointer/modifier/clipboard/dialog evidence, not cursor overlays
Unsupported IME/XWayland/application routes stay on qualified existing path or refuse
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

workItems.title: Optional multiple-device orchestration research
expectedWriteScopes: Separate device-transport/enrollment/host research scope, to be approved later
deliverables: Explicit device enrollment, authenticated caller/device scope and per-device fences
Partition/duplicate/reorder/offline tests and visible partial-failure reconciliation
No global OS input or cross-device atomic-commit claim; no remote connection created by this plan
workItems.completionRule: Complete dependencies and reviewed own deliverables with applicable tests; this item contributes evidence, not automatic passage of the entire phase gate.

executionRules: Never start these work items automatically from this manifest
Read actual latest repository and owner instructions before implementing
Implement on main only; preserve unrelated owner changes
Register each new mandatory test in the default suite with missing-file guard
Re-read actual caller graph and approved write scopes before editing; listed seams are proposals, not proven exhaustive filenames
Do not infer UI resource ownership from cgroup/process leases or agent labels
Do not restart a shared active broker, copy profiles, create a hidden desktop or disable safeguards
Source/test fixture success is not native application-effect acceptance
No Windows/native control, CI restart, remote access, release or deployment is authorized by this plan
gateSemantics: gateContributions lists obligations this item helps establish, not gates that must already pass before the item can finish. Only the declared phase closer may claim a scoped phase-gate result. Partial read-only acceptance never counts as full writer or full-release acceptance.
releaseRule: No capability becomes enabled merely because a work item is complete. Record gate phase, capability scope, exact test coverage and evidence; all applicable full safety obligations must pass before its release.
